items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: Herb was supposed to do the solo on it. And I think he did and they weren’t happy with it.

ctx.x: That is so interesting because I went and revisited that and it’s literally four bars plus a two-beat pick-up. And the fact that it brought you that recognition and that — Herb Alpert had something to do with that song, didn’t he?

Well Burt Bacharach wrote it. And Herb was supposed to do the solo on it. And I think he did and they weren’t happy with it. So I’ll tell you on that session there were three trumpets. It was myself, it was Ollie Mitchell, and Buddy Childers. The three of us. Now at the end of the date — Buddy did the solo first, on flugelhorn. That was another thing, Buddy did it and then after the date was over they asked me to stay and asked me to do it and I did it and that’s the one that was used. Now Buddy thought he had…
